name: Windows ICMP Redirects Not Accepted
description: Ensures Windows does not accept ICMP redirect messages by enforcing EnableICMPRedirects=0, preventing unintended routing manipulation. Required Windows permission: LEA agent account must be allowed to run only: reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v EnableICMPRedirects.

remedy.command: reg add HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v EnableICMPRedirects /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f | Out-Null; reg query HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters /v EnableICMPRedirects
